content-blocking.description: Block approved advertising, tracker, or other privacy-invasive content requests at an implementing runtime.

tracking-resistance.description: Reduce supported tracking behavior using local-first, privacy-minimized runtime controls.

url-cleaning.description: Remove reviewed tracking parameters from supported URL handling paths.

dns-privacy.description: Provide privacy-oriented DNS filtering or policy behavior at an authoritative DNS runtime without exporting raw DNS activity for central status.

network-privacy.description: Provide privacy-preserving encrypted private-network connectivity at an authoritative networking runtime without exporting raw network activity for central status.

telemetry-minimization.description: Minimize optional telemetry or diagnostics collection according to an implementing application's explicit privacy contract.

data-minimization.description: Limit collected or processed data to what an implementing application requires for its documented purpose.

retention-controls.description: Expose or enforce bounded data-retention controls at the authoritative application runtime.

deletion-controls.description: Expose or enforce user-authorized deletion controls at the authoritative application runtime.

portable-export.description: Provide a documented portable export for the implementing application's approved Privacy Shield-owned or privacy-relevant state.

privacy-status.description: Produce minimized Privacy Shield status conforming to the shared status contract without exporting raw private activity.

user-visible-exceptions.description: Expose approved Privacy Shield exceptions or overrides to authorized users without leaking unrelated private activity.
